answer: In arXiv 2501.10391, the existing ontologies identified as most relevant for the AI Act are the AI Risk Ontology (AIRO) and the Vocabulary of AI Risks (VAIR). Their integration into the Data Privacy Vocabulary (DPV) is described as follows: AIRO and VAIR are being integrated for the upcoming DPV version 2.1, and the authors aim to support this integration by identifying the concepts not present in these existing ontologies.
